declaredCandidates.paragraph1: A by-election to fill a vacancy in the office of councillor in Mornington Shire Division 1 was held on Saturday, 15 June 2024.
declaredCandidates.paragraph2: In accordance with section 100 of the Local Government Electoral Act 2011, this notice advises that the following person(s) has been duly elected for Mornington Shire Division 1.
